acip: ,SEMS GNYIS BSKYED PA'I SNGON DU BSTAN BCOS 'DI NAS BSHAD PA LTAR, 'GAL RKYEN SGRIB PA SBYONG BA DANG , MTHUN RKYEN TSOGS GSOG PA SNGON DU BTANG NAS SEMS BSKYED PA NI, DAL 'BYOR GYI RTEN LA SNYING PO LEN PA'I MCHOG TU SHES PAR BYAS NAS 'BAD PAR BYA'O,
wylie: sems gnyis bskyed pa'i sngon du bstan bcos 'di nas bshad pa ltar, 'gal rkyen sgrib pa sbyong ba dang , mthun rkyen tshogs gsog pa sngon du btang nas sems bskyed pa ni, dal 'byor gyi rten la snying po len pa'i mchog tu shes par byas nas 'bad par bya'o
english: As Master Shantideva's text explains, there are certain preliminaries that must be fulfilled before one can develop the wish for enlightenment. We must purify ourselves of the obstacles which are factors that work against being able to develop the wish, and we must gather together all the factors that are conducive to reaching it. You should understand that this process, of undertaking all the preliminaries and then reaching the wish itself, is the very highest way of all to get the essence out of having achieved this human body and mind, with all their spiritual leisure and fortune. As such we must make great efforts in the practice of these preliminaries.
